svg.title: RIEMANN R6 — Heights and the covolume bound: every statement of the chapter, and what each one rests on
svg.desc: The blueprint's chapter 6 in one poster: its 32 statements as cards, each with the Lean declaration it stands for, the statement in words, how its proof goes, and what it uses and is used by. Read it from the foot up: the chapter's theorem, thm-covolume-bound, is at the bottom, and every card stands above the cards whose proofs use it. An arrow from A to B says that the proof of B uses A; a dashed arrow says that the proof of B names A without listing it as a use. The statements that head a section or a group of results have full cards; the others are drawn shorter. The chapter's own introduction: Each member of the families of chap-families carries lattices M_j of rank D. This chapter proves that their covolumes are bounded in terms of the size parameters of the family (thm-covolume-bound). The proof that families exist (thm-family-data-exists) needs this bound. No Lean was built: see diagram R1, band 5.

svg.text: 9 rows. Section by section the chapter runs: 1. Mean arithmetic volumes on flag towers (9); 2. Arithmetic Hilbert-Samuel inequalities (3); 3. Heights on deep covers (3); 4. Integral models and degenerations (4); 5. Toroidal compactifications (9); 6. Resolution of singularities (3). The cards keep that order within a row where the arrows allow.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: depend on the positions of the boundary divisors. …

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Let E be a CM field with a unitary Shimura datum of signature (p, q), p, q ≥ 1, with CM type

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Φ, and let Y be a global integral model of the unitary Shimura variety over the ring of integers

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of its coefficient field (one that descends and dominates the local models of

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thm-unitary-integral-models) with split components. Then: Good towers exist: there is a

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tower T of flag bundles of the Hodge bundles over Y, with line bundles indexed by Φ × {1, …,

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: p+q} (the Chern roots), and a smooth and flat realisation of it with an ample reference model.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and the Hodge bundles, using Hasse's and Landherr's norm theorems (

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two properties of the universal abelian scheme. Fargues' sequence, quotients of abelian

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: schemes by finite flat group schemes, Zarhin's theorem (thm-zarhin-trick) and a

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: statement on ordinary curves show that the de Rham and Hodge–Tate lattices of the

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: universal abelian scheme come from families of Dieudonné lattices …

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: nine geometric quantities of the tower, triviality of the flag bundle on the Hodge part

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (from Fargues' sequence), a flat-degree statement, a statement on twisted

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: automorphisms and two comparison statements for intersection numbers …

svg.text: Let g ≥ 1, let φ be a polarised admissible cone decomposition without self-intersection, and let

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: n ≥ 3 be odd. Let Z be a minimal compactification of A_(g,n): projective and normal over

svg.text: carrying a semi-abelian scheme. Let S → Z be the normalised blow-up along an ideal

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: supported on the boundary whose valuations are those of φ. Then S is smooth of relative

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: dimension g(g+1)/2, and every point of S has a chart of Mumford type.

svg.text: There is a rule that assigns to every variety over a field of characteristic zero a resolution of its

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: singularities, and to every embedded variety a strong embedded resolution (a sequence of

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: blow-ups in smooth centres after which the strict transform is smooth and meets the

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: exceptional divisor with simple normal crossings). The rule commutes with smooth morphisms

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and with extensions of the ground field.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Run the canonical principalisation algorithm, which is correct by

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thm-principalisation-reduces-dimension, on the ideal of the embedded variety.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Functoriality comes from the fact that every invariant the algorithm uses is local and

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: commutes with smooth morphisms and field extensions.

svg.text: The lattices of the families of def-family-data have bounded covolume. That is, for every

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: class of families satisfying the family hypotheses there is C_0 ≥ 0 such that for every large x,

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: every member at scale x and every admissible choice of its data, the lattices M_j of rank D on

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the indefinite side satisfy (2)/(D [K:ℚ])log covol(M_j) ≤ ell_j(C) for all j and all

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: C ≥ C_0, where K is the field of definition and ell_j(C) is the bound that the size parameters

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the family prescribe. We have not unfolded the bound ell_j(C).

svg.text: bundles. The volume bound gives a uniform lower bound for heights on these covers (

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bound on a parameter λ, turns the height bound into the bound on log covol(M_j). We

svg.text: This section proves the lower bound for mean arithmetic volumes of automorphic line

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: which the height argument of sec-ht-deep-covers uses. Over an integral model we

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: build a tower of flag bundles of the Hodge bundles, whose root line bundles make up

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the automorphic line bundles, and prove the volume theorem on it (

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: thm-good-towers-from-arakelov-inputs). The proof needs two facts: the arithmetic

svg.text: self-intersections, less their main term, change sign under simple reflections of the Weyl

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: group (lem-weyl-antisymmetry-intersection), and at the finite places the de Rham

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and Hodge–Tate flags have the same Chern classes (

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: lem-de-rham-hodge-tate-flag-comparison), by Dieudonné theory over mathcal O_C (
